senses.gloss:
हद् cl. 1. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxiii, 8) हदति, ˚ते (pf. जहदे; aor. अहत्त &c. Gr.),
to evacuate, discharge excrement, BhP.; Sarasv.; Kathārṇ. :
Caus. हादयति Gr.:
Desid. जिहत्सते, ib. :
Intens. जाहद्यते, जाहत्ति, ib. [cf. Gk. χέζω.]
हदन n. evacuation of excrement or ordure, L.
हादि m. or f. a spider (= लूता), L.
हद्द m. or हद्दा f. (Arab.) N. of a division of a zodiacal sign (thirty such divisions or degrees are specified; cf. त्रिंशांश), IndSt.; Cat.
हद्देश m. ‘lord of a thirtieth division of a zodiacal sign’, (prob.) a planet, ib.
